name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.cokL
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ), GenBy l R X → cokLen ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ R := by
let I : Submodule ℤ_[l] ℤ_[l] := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l]
let P : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) := Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun _ => I)
let q : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))
have hle : P ≤ q.comap π := by
have hex : ∀ i, ∃ w : ℤ_[l], v i = (l : ℤ_[l]) * w := by
change v i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l] at hi
have hv' : v = (l : ℤ_[l]) • w := funext fun i => by simp [hw i]
have hφ : Function.Surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) := by
have h1 := Module.length_le_of_surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) hφ
have h2 : Module.length ℤ_[l] ((Fin R → ℤ_[l]) ⧸ P) = R := by
show: For every prime ℓ, natural R, and ℤℓ-module X generated by at most R elements, the ℤℓ-length of X/ℓX is at most R.
strategy: Present the quotient by R copies of the simple residue module.

steps.claim: Since the ℤℓ-module X admits R generators, choose a surjection π from ℤℓ^R onto X. Let I be the maximal ideal of ℤℓ. When R = 0 the source is zero, so X is zero as well.
steps.snippet:
∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Type) [AddCommGroup X] [Module ℤ_[l] X] (R : ℕ), GenBy l R X → cokLen ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X)) ≤ R := by
  intro l _ X _ _ R hgen
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := hgen
  classical
  let I : Submodule ℤ_[l] ℤ_[l] := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l]

steps.claim: The residue module ℤℓ/I is simple. Its submodules correspond to the ideals between I and ℤℓ, and maximality leaves only the two endpoints.
steps.snippet:
have hsimple : IsSimpleModule ℤ_[l] (ℤ_[l] ⧸ I) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.2 (Ideal.isMaximal_def.1 (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal ℤ_[l]))

steps.claim: Let P be the submodule of ℤℓ^R consisting of vectors with every coordinate in I, and let q be the image of multiplication by ℓ on X. Thus q = ℓX.
steps.snippet:
let P : Submodule ℤ_[l] (Fin R → ℤ_[l]) := Submodule.pi Set.univ (fun _ => I)
  let q : Submodule ℤ_[l] X := LinearMap.range ((l : ℤ_[l]) • (1 : Module.End ℤ_[l] X))

steps.claim: One has P ⊆ π⁻¹(q). Indeed, I is generated by ℓ, so a vector v in P is ℓ times some w in ℤℓ^R, and linearity gives π(v) = ℓπ(w) in q.
steps.snippet: have hle : P ≤ q.comap π := by

children.claim: For v in P, each coordinate vᵢ lies in I because P imposes the condition of membership in I at every index.
children.snippet:
intro v hv
    rw [Submodule.mem_pi] at hv

children.claim: For every i there is a wᵢ in ℤℓ with vᵢ = ℓwᵢ. This follows from vᵢ ∈ I and the equality of the maximal ideal of ℤℓ with the principal ideal generated by ℓ.
children.snippet:
have hex : ∀ i, ∃ w : ℤ_[l], v i = (l : ℤ_[l]) * w := by
      intro i
      have hi := hv i (Set.mem_univ i)
      change v i ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ℤ_[l] at hi
      rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hi
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hi
      exact ⟨a, by rw [← ha, mul_comm]⟩

children.claim: Choose one such quotient wᵢ for each of the R coordinates. These choices form a vector w in ℤℓ^R satisfying vᵢ = ℓwᵢ at every index.
Coordinatewise scalar multiplication gives (ℓw)ᵢ = ℓwᵢ = vᵢ, hence v = ℓw.
children.snippet: have hv' : v = (l : ℤ_[l]) • w := funext fun i => by simp [hw i]

children.claim: The element π(w) maps to π(v) under multiplication by ℓ, since ℓπ(w) = π(ℓw) = π(v). Thus π(v) lies in q.
children.snippet:
rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_range]
    refine ⟨π w, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.End.one_apply, hv', map_smul]

steps.claim: The inclusion P ⊆ π⁻¹(q) induces a map ℤℓ^R/P → X/q. Any class represented by x has a preimage represented by v with π(v) = x, since π is onto. The induced map is therefore surjective.
steps.snippet:
have hφ : Function.Surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) := by
    intro z
    refine Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ z ?_
    intro x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hπ x
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk v, Submodule.mapQ_apply _ _ _ _⟩

steps.claim: A surjective linear map bounds the length of its target by that of its source. Hence length(X/q) ≤ length(ℤℓ^R/P), with lengths over ℤℓ.
steps.snippet: have h1 := Module.length_le_of_surjective (P.mapQ q π hle) hφ

steps.claim: Taking the quotient coordinatewise identifies ℤℓ^R/P with R copies of ℤℓ/I. Finite product lengths add, and each simple residue module has length one, so the source length is R.
steps.snippet:
have h2 : Module.length ℤ_[l] ((Fin R → ℤ_[l]) ⧸ P) = R := by
    rw [(Submodule.quotientPi (fun _ : Fin R => I)).length_eq, Module.length_pi_of_fintype]
    simp [Module.length_eq_one]
steps.typedFact: Module.length ℤ_[l] ((Fin R → ℤ_[l]) ⧸ P) = R

steps.claim: The surjection and the source length R give length(X/ℓX) ≤ R. This is the cokernel length of multiplication by ℓ, and it is zero when R = 0.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
